dedupe_keys.name: pjm data miner 2 public market and operations data feeds with api pjm interconnection

description: Data Miner 2 is PJM Interconnection's data management tool for the public market and operations data formerly posted on pjm.com. According to the tool's own description, it gives members and non-members access to the data with an architecture with monitoring of data quality and development of new data feeds; users can search and filter data by hand, and with a pjm.com account can run automatic queries through its APIs. Coverage: the PJM region. Format and access: a web application listing data feeds, with download and API access; browsing is free, and API use requires a pjm.com account. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): PJM Data Miner 2 terms of use: internal business or commercial use permitted, including publishing and derivatives, under the PJM data licence agreement. Caveats: the application is script-driven, so the list of feeds (which PJM documents on a data availability page) and the retention period were not read. Simulation uses: load, generation, prices and transmission constraints for capacity planning, optimisation and resilience studies of the PJM grid. Related records: the gridstatus library (data-gridstatus) wraps PJM data, and ERCOT market information (data-ercot-market-information-and-data-access-portal) is the Texas counterpart.
